title: Implement Merkle Hash Functions in C#
description: Implement deterministic SHA-256 Merkle hash functions for all entities in C# (Semio.cs), change float to double precision, and add hash tests in Tests.cs.
summary: Re-verified the completed cross-language Merkle hashing work in the live workspace. Confirmed the canonical metabolism kit hash test passes in TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, and C# net8.0, the C# JavaScript-threshold number-format regression test remains in place, and the temporary Go debug file is absent.
